algebraic_independence: The two primitive transfer vectors are Z-linearly independent; e.g. the 2x2 minor on x,y coordinates is (-1)*1-0*1=-1 != 0.

covariance.coordinate_permutation: Intrinsic form is repeat the previous donor relation. Any coordinate permutation sends (recipient,donor) to (pi(recipient),pi(donor)), preserving the equality relation between successive transfers.
covariance.global_inversion: Vector form T_{k+1}=T_k maps to -T_{k+1}=-T_k; the continuation law is covariant. No Euclidean notion is used.
covariance.transverse_exchange: tau swaps the two transfer vectors and sends h->1-h, b->1-b; b_next=h is equivariant.

straightness_definition: A sequence is straight only when its displacement vectors generate a rank-one integer submodule.
theorem: A repeated fixed-recipient sequence has rank-one transfer span iff all realized branch bits are equal. Hence every continuation step satisfies b_{k+1}=b_k.
